title: Automatic deletion
description: Permanently deletes recordings older than the period (counted from the time of recording): transcript, summary and stored audio, archived or not. The period is the upper limit for everyone; users can choose a shorter one for their own recordings in their profile.
daysInvalid: Please enter a whole number between 1 and 3650.
daysInvalidToast: The period must be a whole number between 1 and 3650
hint: Checked every 6 hours; changes apply without a restart. Recordings whose transcription is still running are skipped. Every run that deletes something appears in the audit log.
warning: Deleted recordings, audio included, cannot be recovered. Transfer texts to the patient record in time.
